auto-assign-service-ports.description: Auto assign service ports for tasks which use IP-per-task. See https://github.com/mesosphere/marathon-lb#mesos-with-ip-per-task-support for details.

bind-http-https.description: Reserve ports 80 and 443 for the LB. Use this if you intend to use virtual hosts.

cpus.description: CPU shares to allocate to each marathon-lb instance.

haproxy-group.description: HAProxy group parameter. Matches with HAPROXY_GROUP in the app labels.

haproxy-map.description: Enable HAProxy VHost maps for fast VHost routing.

mem.description: Memory (MB) to allocate to each marathon-lb task.

role.description: Deploy marathon-lb only on nodes with this role.

secret_name.description: Name of the Secret Store credentials to use for DC/OS service authentication. This should be left empty unless service authentication is needed.

ssl-cert.description: TLS Cert and private key for HTTPS.

strict-mode.description: Enable strict mode. This requires that you explicitly enable each backend with `HAPROXY_{n}_ENABLED=true`.

description:
We are rolling out a new Marathon‑LB instance named **marathon‑lb** with the following resource and deployment settings: each task will be allocated **2 CPU shares** and **1024 MB of memory**, and we will run **2 instances** in total. The load balancer will be bound to ports 80 and 443 (bind‑http‑https enabled) and will not auto‑assign service ports for IP‑per‑task workloads. It will be restricted to agents bearing the **slave_public** role, using the **lb‑secret** secret for DC/OS service authentication. The HAProxy group is set to **external**, with HAProxy maps enabled, and the global default options are configured as **redispatch,http-server-close,dontlognull**. Strict mode is disabled, and the minimum health capacity is **0.5** while the maximum over‑capacity allowance is **0.2**. The Marathon endpoint is **http://marathon.mesos:8080**. Docker launch parameters include **env=PRODUCTION** and **log‑driver=json‑file**.

The HAProxy configuration will be customized using the template archive located at **https://example.com/haproxy-templates.tar.gz**, and the following sysctl parameters will be applied at startup: **net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1 net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout=30 net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog=10240 net.ipv4.tcp_max_tw_buckets=400000 net.ipv4.tcp_max_orphans=60000 net.core.somaxconn=10000**.
